revision_history.stage: 1005-7 final (set after geometry-only inspection, before any response look)
revision_history.change: Added IoU>=0.25 for strict 1:1 (IoU>=0.5 would have rejected ~75% of otherwise clean 1:1 pairs because Natural Earth 1:10m urban polygons and GHSL DoU centres are different ontologies; median 1:1 IoU=0.39). 'Overlap>=0.5' redefined as overlap/min(area) to define a substantive link, since containment of a small object in a large one is the expected relation. IoU>=0.5 reported as tight sensitivity flag.

classes.A_strict_1to1: isolated link component (1 UCDB, 1 YCEO), IoU>=0.25, area ratio in [0.25,4], centroid distance<=25km
classes.B_dominant_1to1: cluster holds >=2 UCDB centres but one holds >=80% of UCDB-overlap area and covers >=50% of cluster
classes.C_ambiguous_one_to_many: one UCDB centre substantively overlaps >=2 clusters
classes.D_many_to_one_ambiguous / D_minor_of_dom: several UCDB centres in one cluster with no dominant one / minor centres beside a dominant one
classes.E_cross_country_cluster: UCDB centres of a cluster belong to different countries

unit_rule: Recommended primary unit = YCEO cluster. A cluster is a unit iff star-shaped (all its UCDB centres link only to it), single-country, response valid, all linked centres in the 10,915 sample, and UCDB centres cover >=50% of cluster area. Each cluster appears once; S/H are aggregated over its UCDB centres.
name_and_country_use: YCEO has no name or country field; cross-country consistency among UCDB centres of one cluster is the only country QA possible. Names are not used.
tight_sensitivity: restrict to units whose all links have IoU>=0.5
